headline: Quint Digital's September 2026 net sales fall 24.3% YoY to Rs 1.33 crore
summary: Quint Digital posted standalone net sales of Rs 1.33 crore for September 2026, down 24.29% compared with September 2025. The decline was reported in the company's latest financial filing. The fall in revenue may weigh on the company's profitability and share price. Investors in the media sector should note the slowdown.
why_it_matters: Sales slump may pressure share price

headline: Quint Digital reports 371% revenue growth for September quarter
summary: Quint Digital Media reported consolidated net sales of Rs 36.78 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. This represents a 371.84% increase compared to the same period last year. The company's performance reflects significant year-on-year expansion in its digital media operations.
why_it_matters: Strong revenue growth may boost investor sentiment for the stock.

headline: Quint Digital's Q2 FY27 revenue rose 372% YoY to ₹36.78 crore, driven by its Quintype media‑tech expansion.
summary: Quint Digital reported a 372% year‑on‑year increase in Q2 FY27 revenue, reaching ₹36.78 crore. The surge was attributed to rapid adoption of its Quintype media‑technology platform and expanded service offerings. This strong top‑line performance improves the company's profitability outlook and may attract investor interest in the Indian digital media sector. Retail investors could see heightened exposure to a fast‑growing tech‑media play.
